summary.zh: Cursor 可在没有本地仓库时从 GitHub 发布包更新：下载后校验 SHA-256、归档路径与每个插件的身份和版本，全部通过才替换 ~/.cursor/plugins/local 下的插件并读回；check 与 update 对 Cursor 不可用的口径一致；发布工作流在上传前校验 release.json 与归档。
summary.en: Cursor can update from a GitHub release archive without a local checkout: the download is verified for SHA-256, archive paths and each plugin's identity and version before anything under ~/.cursor/plugins/local is replaced, then read back; check and update agree when Cursor is unavailable; the release workflow validates release.json and the archive before publishing.
